args.lesson: What worked: anchoring both insertions on unique existing strings and asserting a reverse removal let a single EXEC produce the diff, hashes and 16/16 scope and link checks. The offer wording was taken only from the capability-check items that verify.py actually ran. What failed: reading the diff afterwards showed the FR said 'Livrable testé' (a tested deliverable) while the EN said 'deliverable we are testing'. That cost a second EXEC and dry_run, and index.diff is now one phrase stale. Next time: diff the EN/FR claim words before the first dry_run.
